pf.license.need: always: each pharmacist holds their own active license from the state where the patient is during the visit; the pharmacy holds the state's pharmacy permit; whether a pharmacist needs extra vaccine training or a certificate, and whether trained technicians or interns may give shots, comes from the state's form (a switch)
pf.license.ask: each pharmacist's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the pharmacy's permit number from the owner; each person's vaccine training certificate where the state's form asks for one
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.ages: the youngest age a pharmacist may vaccinate, vaccine by vaccine, comes from the state's form (a switch); Rosie never offers a shot to someone younger
pf.license.prescription: which vaccines need a prescriber's order, and for which ages, comes from the state's form (a switch); such a shot is booked only once the order is on file at the pharmacy
pf.license.video: a video medicine review only with a pharmacist licensed (or otherwise allowed by the state's rules) in the state where the patient will be during the call; nobody allowed there: no video times, and a review at the pharmacy is offered instead
pf.license.away: home visits and shot clinics away from the pharmacy only where the state's rules allow them, with any registration the state's form asks for (a switch)
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.registry: where the state's rules require it, the pharmacy is enrolled with the state's immunization registry and reports each shot from its own records (a switch); Rosie never sends to the registry
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance where the state's form asks for it

pf.services.shape: short shot visits of a set length, booked with a pharmacist by name or with whoever is on, with a 15-minute wait after every shot built into the booking; two or three shots fit in one visit and one wait; a shot is offered only while it's in stock, and its doses are set aside when the visit is booked; walk-ins are welcome when a pharmacist is free; medicine reviews at the pharmacy or by video; Rosie books shots and medicine reviews only, never prescriptions, refills or transfers
pf.services.examples: the example pharmacy's own prices (Lee Pharmacy and Lee Mobile Pharmacy), not a standard; a health or drug plan pays its own fee, and the patient's share is an estimate, often nothing for a shot the plan covers; nothing is ever promised as free

pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult books for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for a child, only from the youngest age the state's form allows for that shot (a switch); another adult (a grown child, a caregiver) only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; someone under 18 never books alone
pf.questions.whoMayBring: a parent or legal guardian brings a child and stays for the whole visit and the wait; another adult brings a child only with the parent's signed OK on the secure page, where the state's rules allow it; an adult patient may bring anyone they like
pf.questions.neverAsked: health details, reactions, medicines and symptoms are never asked or typed in the AI chat: only on the secure page

stop.words: signs of a severe allergic reaction: trouble breathing, swelling of the face, lips or throat, hives spreading fast, or fainting after a shot
stop.say: Call 911 now. If you have an epinephrine pen, use it. Don't wait for a booking.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked until the pharmacy calls

stop.words: chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or very heavy bleeding
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now. Don't wait for a booking.

stop.words: an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

pharmacistLine.words: a question about a medicine, a missed dose, a side effect that isn't an emergency, or a refill
pharmacistLine.say: A pharmacist answers that. Please call the pharmacy at (555) 010-0177. If it's an emergency, call 911.
pharmacistLine.booking: no answer from Rosie; a shot or review can still be booked if the person asks for one

pf.visit.checkIn: at the pharmacy: the check-in code at the counter, then the pharmacist checks the photo ID and the plan cards against the secure page; a video review: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the patient at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the pharmacist goes over the screening answers with the patient, asks how they feel today, and gives the vaccine information sheet for each shot before it's given
pf.visit.changes: another shot is added only with the patient's yes, if it's in stock and the screening answers cover it, with any self-pay price first; a shot waits for another day if the patient is sick or the pharmacist says so
pf.visit.wait: every patient stays 15 minutes after the shot (longer if the pharmacist says so), seated where staff can see them; signs of a severe allergic reaction: the emergency plan and 911 right away
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the shots, lot numbers and any reaction go in the pharmacy's own records, never in Rosie or a text
pf.visit.records: where the state's rules require it, the pharmacy reports each shot to the state's immunization registry from its own records; the patient gets a printed or portal record of each shot
pf.visit.away: at home: the pharmacist brings the vaccines in a cooler, the emergency kit and the information sheets, and stays for the 15-minute wait
pf.visit.childLeft: never: the adult who brings a child stays for the whole visit and the wait

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking: no card, no hold, no deposit; at home: nothing taken
pf.money.plans: the plans the pharmacy takes (its own list); a flu or COVID-19 shot is usually billed to the health plan, other shots often to the drug plan; the pharmacy checks each plan by hand or by a trial claim and records it; the share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient sees the price before saying yes, is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.fees: none: no cancel fee and no missed-visit fee, ever
pf.money.feeFree: every patient is fee-free; texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'

pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form (no deposits are taken); price limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules

pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the patient needs an interpreter, and the pharmacy is told

pf.messages.medical: a medical or medicine question is never answered, saved or passed on by Rosie: 911 if it's an emergency, then the pharmacy's own line, where a pharmacist answers

pf.staff.licenses: each pharmacist's own license, per state, plus any vaccine training certificate the state's form asks for
pf.staff.skills: pharmacists: shots, medicine reviews, home shot visits and shot clinics; only people cleared for home visits go to homes; trained technicians or interns give shots only where the state's form allows it, under a pharmacist (a switch)
pf.staff.supervision: a technician or intern who gives shots works under a pharmacist on site, where the state's form allows it at all
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs a shot clinic's date and host, a home visit on a day nobody is cleared for, and anything a pharmacist flags
pf.staff.standIn: a pharmacist out: another pharmacist may take the visit, with the patient's yes; nobody is moved without it
pf.staff.away: the home visit team is the pharmacists cleared for home visits, with the vaccine cooler and the emergency kit

pf.rules.noPrescriptions: Rosie books shots and medicine reviews only; it never fills, refills or transfers a prescription, and points those requests to the pharmacy's own line
pf.rules.ages: the youngest age a pharmacist may vaccinate, shot by shot, from the state's form (a switch); a child is booked only by a parent or guardian, and never below that age
pf.rules.prescription: the shots that need a prescriber's order, and for which ages, from the state's form (a switch)
pf.rules.infoSheet: the vaccine information sheet for each shot is given before that shot, every time
pf.rules.wait: a 15-minute wait after every shot, built into each booking
pf.rules.registry: each shot reported to the state's immunization registry where the state's rules require it, by the pharmacy from its own records, with the patient's consent where the state asks for it (a switch)
pf.rules.reactions: a serious reaction after a shot is reported by the pharmacist to the federal vaccine safety system, as the federal rules require
pf.rules.records: the pharmacy keeps its records as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the pharmacy's records
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their shot record within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: the permit and licenses shown where the state asks: posted at the pharmacy, and at a clinic or visit away from it
pf.rules.proxies: an adult booking for another adult needs that patient's OK, or papers that show they're the guardian or health care agent, where the state's rules ask for them
pf.rules.estimate: a written price estimate for self-pay patients, by the deadline the federal rules set (a switch keeps the pharmacy's own faster rule)
pf.rules.host: a workplace's or care home's clinic day only under the host's written OK and its sign-in rules
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for shots or care given at a visit, at the pharmacy or at home; where a state's rules give one for something sold at the home, it goes in writing (a switch)

pf.edges.outOfStock: a shot runs out: only times after the next delivery are offered; a booked dose that's lost (a late delivery, a fridge alarm) is told to the patient on the secure page, with the other shots kept and new times offered, no fee
pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 10 minutes late: still seen; later, the pharmacist fits the patient in or offers a new time (the pharmacy decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.pharmacyLate: when the pharmacy runs late, a new time costs nothing
pf.edges.standIn: a pharmacist out: another pharmacist, with the patient's yes, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: screening questions not done by their due date (a booking the pharmacy made by phone): one reminder, then the patient answers them at the counter before the shot
pf.edges.sickToday: a patient who feels sick on the day: the pharmacist decides if the shot waits; a new time is booked with no fee, and the doses stay set aside
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with the price and the estimate notice, or a free cancel; a plan that changes on a new year: the page asks for the new card before a later dose
pf.edges.seriesDue: a second dose is booked at checkout inside its window; if it can't be, Rosie reminds the patient once when the window opens
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with two visits open (a shot and a medicine review): Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.worse: someone feels unwell before the visit: the 911 or Poison Help words if they match; anything else goes to the pharmacist on the secure page; Rosie never judges it, and the visit stays booked
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about a shot or a medicine: never answered by Rosie; 911 if it's an emergency, then the pharmacy's own line
pf.edges.refill: a refill or prescription request by text, chat or call: Rosie says the pharmacy handles it on its own line and books nothing
pf.edges.homebound: a home visit that can't happen as booked: the soonest open window comes first, with no fee
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
pf.edges.urgent: no shot is sent now and nobody is on call: the soonest times show first; the danger words get 911
